He played [[college basketball]] for the [[West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball|West Virginia Mountaineers]] and previously played for the [[College of Southern Idaho]] and [[Moberly Area Community College]]. ==High school career== Paige attended [[Jamestown High School (New York)|Jamestown High School]] in [[Jamestown, New York]], where he played football and basketball. He was named Western New York Player of the Year after leading Jamestown to a state runner-up finish as a junior. He averaged 27 points and eight rebounds per game that season. As a senior, he transferred to Perry County Central High School in [[Hazard, Kentucky]], where he posted averages of 21 points and 6.7 rebounds per game.{{cite web|title=Jaysean Paige #5 G|url=http://www.wvusports.com/profile.cfm?sport=mbball&id=103021|accessdate=March 14, 2016|website=[[West Virginia University]]}} ==College career== Paige attended the [[College of Southern Idaho]] as a freshman, where he averaged 13.6 points, 4.4 rebounds, and 2.1 steals per game. He transferred to [[Moberly Area Community College]] as a sophomore, and averaged over 21 points and four rebounds per game. in May 2014, he signed with West Virginia to play under [[Bob Huggins]].{{cite news|title=West Virginia signs juco transfer Jaysean Paige|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2014/05/20/west-virginia-signs-juco-transfer-jaysean-paige/9337675/|accessdate=March 13, 2016|work=[[USA Today]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=May 20, 2014}} He had considered [[Southern Mississippi Golden Eagles men's basketball|Southern Miss]], but decided not to commit after [[Donnie Tyndall]] was fired.{{cite news|last1=Taylor|first1=Allan|title=Senior moments: Paige, Holton made most of transfers to WVU|url=http://wvmetronews.com/2016/03/02/senior-moments-paige-holton-made-most-of-transfers-to-west-virginia/|accessdate=March 13, 2016|work=WV Metro News|date=March 2, 2016}} As a junior, he averaged 5.6 points and 1.9 rebounds per game, starting 10 games. His season-high 18 points came against [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]] in the Big 12 Championship. Paige was the team's [[sixth man]] as a senior, a role he relished. Against first-ranked [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]], Paige had 26 points, five steals and four rebounds as the Mountaineers upset the Jayhawks 74–63.{{cite news|last1=Vingle|first1=Mitch|title=Paige provides the drive for big WVU win|url=http://www.wvgazettemail.com/sports/20160112/mitch-vingle-paige-provides-the-drive-for-big-wvu-win|accessdate=March 14, 2016|work=[[Charleston Gazette-Mail]]|date=January 12, 2016}} He scored a career-high 34 points in a 97–87 victory over [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]] on February 22.{{cite news |author1=John Raby |title=West Virginia's deep bench led by top scorer Jaysean Paige |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/west-virginias-deep-bench-led-top-scorer-jaysean-190333921--ncaab.html|accessdate=13 March 2016 |work=[[Yahoo Sports]] |agency=[[The Associated Press]] |date=25 February 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170124231806/https://sports.yahoo.com/news/west-virginias-deep-bench-led-top-scorer-jaysean-190333921--ncaab.html |archive-date=24 January 2017}} Paige averaged 14.3 point per game in his senior season. He was named to the Second Team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] and was the conference Sixth man Award honoree (unanimous selection).{{cite web|title=Nation's Best Lead All-Big 12 Men's Basketball Awards |url=http://www.big12sports.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_LANG=C&ATCLID=210776703&DB_OEM_ID=10410 |website=Big 12 Sports |accessdate=March 6, 2016 |date=March 6, 2016}} ==Professional career== ===Oettinger Rockets Gotha (2016)=== He went undrafted in the 2016 NBA Draft. He signed with [[Oettinger Rockets Gotha]] of Germany's [[2. Basketball Bundesliga|Pro A]] league on August 8, 2016.[https://web.archive.org/web/20170124231612/http://www.schoenen-dunk.de/news_a83673_ProA_Oettinger-Rockets-verpflichten-Jaysean-Paige.htm Oettinger Rockets verpflichten Jaysean Paige] {{in lang|de}} ===Karpoš Sokoli (2017)=== On 26 November 2016, he signed with [[KK Karpoš Sokoli|Karpoš Sokoli]]{{cite web|url=https://www.gol.mk/kosharka/amerikanecot-pejdzh-sleta-megju-sokolite|title=Американецот Пејџ "слета" меѓу "соколите"|date=November 25, 2016 |publisher=gol.mk|accessdate=26 November 2016}}{{cite web|url=http://sportmedia.mk/kosharka/aba-liga/kraj-na-prestojot-vo-karposh-za-pejdzh|title=Крај на престојот во Карпош за Пејџ|work=Sportmedia |date=January 6, 2017 |publisher=sportmedia.mk|accessdate=6 January 2017}} ===Newcastle Eagles (2017–2018)=== On 8 August 2017 Paige signed for the seven-time [[British Basketball League]] champions [[Newcastle Eagles]].
